answer.summary: Formulate a clear, bounded research question to evaluate memory fidelity in tokenized agents under periodic input and known perturbations, using only the explicitly reported 'fidelity score' from Section 6.1 of Wang et al., 2024, and its variation
answer.content: The research question must be narrowly focused on measuring how the fidelity score changes over 50 update intervals under a fixed token budget of 100 tokens with periodic input and known perturbations, relying exclusively on experimentally reported data from Wang et al., 2024, Section 6.1. The question must avoid referencing retention, efficiency, or coherence and must be verifiable through direct metric reporting only. Acceptance criteria include explicit reference to the fidelity score, bounded conditions, and alignment with peer-reviewed, reported outcomes. No speculative or indirect metrics are permitted.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to formulate a revised research question on memory fidelity in tokenized agents under periodic input with known perturbations, anchored solely to the 'fidelity score' metric explicitly reported in Section 6.1 of 'Fidelity and Drift in Sequential Memory Systems' by Wang et al., 2024, and including its variation over 50 update intervals under a bounded token budget of 100 tokens
answer.lesson: All memory research questions must be strictly anchored to a single, explicitly defined, and experimentally reported metric from peer-reviewed sources to ensure empirical validity and avoid speculative generalization.'
